reason: Overrides are built as fake-UTC wall-clock Dates (packages/core/getUserAvailability.ts:221-222). The patch reads the timezone offset at that fake instant in packages/lib/slots.ts:44-45 (`dayjs(override.start.toString()).tz(...).utcOffset()`) and in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:105 (`dayjs.tz(date.start, organizerTimeZone)`). The fake instant is off from the real local instant by the full UTC offset, so if a DST switch falls between the two (e.g. a 03:00 override on New York's spring-forward day), the wrong offset is applied.
